The '''Chelsaine Palace''' is located in [[Ebou Dar]].

[[Matrim Cauthon]] once followed [[Lady Shiaine]] to the palace. Mat later learns from [[Noal Charin]] that the palace is being rented by [[Jaichim Carridin]], the [[Whitecloak]] Ambassador.{{ref/book|7|14}}

[[Sammael]] visits the palace and Carridin to discover that Mat is in Ebou Dar. Sammael then leaves Carridin instructions regarding Mat.{{ref/book|7|15}}

The palace is staked out by various members of Mat's party during their stay in Ebou Dar, including Mat himself, [[Vanin]], and [[Birgitte]].{{ref/book|7|17}}
